record.paper_title: Structural results on circular-arc graphs and circle graphs: A survey and the main open problems
record.original_question: Find forbidden induced subgraph characterizations for Helly circular-arc graphs. A circular-arc graph is an intersection graph of open arcs on a circle; a Helly circular-arc graph is one having a circular-arc model in which every pairwise intersecting subfamily of arcs has a common point. The requested work includes both a minimal-forbidden-induced-subgraph characterization within the class of circular-arc graphs and a forbidden-induced-subgraph characterization that does not assume in advance that the input graph is circular-arc.

evidence.quote: Problem 5. Find a characterization by forbidden induced subgraphs for Helly circular-arc graphs.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A circular-arc graph is a graph that can be represented as the intersection graph of a family of open arcs on a circle; such a family is called a circular-arc model of the graph. A circular-arc graph is said to be a Helly circular-arc graph if it admits a circular-arc model with the Helly property, namely, every subfamily of arcs that is pairwise intersecting has a common point.

Provide forbidden induced subgraph characterizations of the class of Helly circular-arc graphs, in the following two senses:

(a) Determine the complete list of minimal forbidden induced subgraphs for Helly circular-arc graphs within the class of circular-arc graphs; i.e., describe all graphs G that are circular-arc but not Helly circular-arc, such that every proper induced subgraph of G is Helly circular-arc.

(b) Determine the complete list of minimal forbidden induced subgraphs for the class of Helly circular-arc graphs among all graphs, without assuming a priori that the graph is a circular-arc graph.
artifact.status_search_result: Part (a), the characterization by minimal forbidden induced subgraphs within the class of circular-arc graphs, has been obtained: the "essential obstacles" are precisely the minimal forbidden induced circular-arc subgraphs for Helly circular-arc graphs, with a linear-time identification algorithm. For part (b), only partial results are known, e.g., a minimal forbidden induced subgraph characterization restricted to graphs containing no induced claw and no induced 5-wheel; the general forbidden induced subgraph characterization (without assuming the graph is circular-arc) remains open.

status_evidence.title: Essential obstacles to Helly circular-arc graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Essential obstacles are precisely the minimal forbidden induced circular-arc subgraphs for the class of Helly circular-arc graphs... partial answer: minimal forbidden induced subgraph characterization for Helly circular-arc graphs restricted to graphs containing no induced claw and no induced 5-wheel.
status_evidence.claim: Within circular-arc graphs the obstructions are characterized; the unrestricted forbidden induced subgraph characterization remains open.

status_evidence.title: Forbidden Induced Subgraphs of Normal Helly Circular-Arc Graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Characterization and detection of forbidden induced subgraphs for the subclass of normal Helly circular-arc graphs.
status_evidence.claim: The related subclass of normal Helly circular-arc graphs has a known forbidden induced subgraph characterization, but this is a different (smaller) class.
